REJECT
The refactor names three types the original never spelled out (`JsInventory.Inventory`, `JsInventory.Selection`, `JsInventory.Package`), and the existing code suggests they won't resolve: its other types are top-level `Js*` names (`JsTestUnit`, `JsConfigExclusion`), so the build very likely breaks; I couldn't find the repo here to compile it, and the logic and complexity otherwise look fine apart from `Runs(s)` now being evaluated eagerly.
